description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Cecil (Dark Knight))] and [Darkness Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Cecil (Dark Knight))
description.text: Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Darkness abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Darkness abilities, Darkness abilities deal 10%/20%/30% more damage if the user has suffered 4000/8000/12000+ recoil damage
